purpose: Does a signalled session exit, write no payload, leave no surviving process, and leave its transcript unchanged afterwards? SIGTERM is delivered by timeout at 25 seconds, mid-work.
argv: Write a detailed 4000-word essay on the history of the wheel into the relative file `report.md` using the write tool. Then, and only after the essay file exists, write the single word `DONE` into the relative file `payload.json`. Do not stop early and do not summarise; produce the full essay.
command_line: timeout -s TERM 25 claude -p --session-id 69b13839-307b-40b5-97c4-f0c0c70313e8 --model claude-sonnet-5 --effort high --restricted --tools Bash,Read,Write,Edit,Glob,Grep,Agent,Task --allowedTools Write Edit 'Bash(python3:*)' 'Bash(cat:*)' 'Bash(ls:*)' --permission-prompts none --max-budget-usd 1.00 --output-format json 'Write a detailed 4000-word essay on the history of the wheel into the relative file `report.md` using the write tool. Then, and only after the essay file exists, write the single word `DONE` into the relative file `payload.json`. Do not stop early and do not summarise; produce the full essay.'
